column2: Why can a report of "susceptible" fail to predict cure?
column3: A prescription only succeeds if enough free drug reaches the infected site, so susceptibility cannot compensate for an undrained abscess, obstructed kidney, infected prosthesis, or dose that never reaches the compartment.
